derivedConventionDictionary.coexactOneForms: A=1,2 each k≥1, ell=1,...,k, m=−ell,...,ell. Paper rough eigenvalue of ∇^a∇_a is1−k(k+2). Positive Hodge Δ_H=−∇²+Ric has μ=k(k+2)+1=(k+1)²; positive rough eigenvalue μ−2.
derivedConventionDictionary.exactOneForms: A=0 gradient harmonics, k≥1, rough positive eigenvalue λ−2.
derivedConventionDictionary.gradientEnergy: On exact one-forms df, ||L_(grad f)κ||²=4(λ−2)||df||². This is an integrated identity, not pointwise control of all derivatives by symmetric gradient.
derivedConventionDictionary.killingIdentification: Derived integrated identity ||L_Vκ||²=2(||∇V||²+||divV||²−2||V||²) gives 2(μ−4)||V||² on coexact modes. Thus the6-dimensional μ4 sector is Killing, agreeing with six ambient rotations.
derivedConventionDictionary.metric: unit round S3, Ric=2κ; for radius R3 divide eigenvalues by R3²
derivedConventionDictionary.multiplicity: Both coexact families together give2 sum_(ell=1)^k(2ell+1)=2k(k+2). At k=1, μ=4 has dimension6; next coexact k=2 has μ=9.
derivedConventionDictionary.remainingGap: After removing Killing modes, conservative coexact μ≥9. Reflection-invariant subsector may have a larger gap; μ9 is not claimed to occur there.
derivedConventionDictionary.scope: Unit angular geometry only. Restoring radius factors and warped-product connection/radial couplings is a separate model calculation.
